text_sanskrit: प्रकृत्यैव च कर्माणि क्रियमाणानि सर्वशः । यः पश्यति तथात्मानमकर्तारं स पश्यति ॥ १३-३० ॥
itrans: prakR^ityaiva cha karmANi kriyamANAni sarvashaH . yaH pashyati tathAtmAnamakartAraM sa pashyati .. 13-30 ..
translation: And he who sees that all actions performed are begun and done by the Lord Himself and also that Paramâtma (the Lord) is without a maker.
